about: Span-level extractions: which exact words of each provision carry which piece of a parameter. Each span's text must appear verbatim in the provision. tools/build_web.py locates it, re-parses dates and number words with deterministic code, and fails if the parsed value differs from 'normalized'.
extracted_by: Claude (language model), by reading the provision text. Not reviewed by a lawyer.

classes.period: The tax years the provision covers
classes.base: What the number is applied to
classes.exception: A cross-reference that can displace the provision
classes.effect: A consequence other than a number
classes.threshold: An income amount where a rate starts or stops
